scope: Untimed Vort work-accounting caller allocator verification only; no wall or RSS data, no C/reference encoder
concurrent_environment: Parent family/check on CPUs2-7,10-12; probe compilation CPUs13-15 and encoding CPU8
requested_heap_scope: Requests through public caller page_allocator wrapper, including returned output until explicit caller free; excludes embedded input, codec/tracker stack, code mappings and allocator bookkeeping/page rounding.
limits: One public level3 XML64KiB encode per binary plus one tiny forced first-allocation OOM; page_allocator requested byte ledger includes returned output until caller free and excludes input/stack/code/page rounding. No 14-sample repetition.
